title: Asymptotic self-similar blow-up for the regularized Saint-Venant equations
summary: We investigate singularity formation in the regularized Saint--Venant (rSV) equations, a conservative, non-dispersive shallow water system that is formally regarded as a Hamiltonian regularization of the isentropic Euler equations. While it is known that smooth solutions to the rSV system can develop gradient blow-up in finite time, the precise structure of such singularities has not been rigorously characterized.
